author: Kushal
problem: A car's odometer shows six digits and rolls back to 000000 after 999999. Given the reading before a trip and the kilometres driven, return the number it shows after the trip.
bug_description: Takes the total modulo 999999 instead of 1000000, so the display wraps one step early: 999999 shows as 0 and every reading after a rollover is one too high.

comments.accurate: Returns the six-digit reading after the trip, rolling over past 999999
comments.wrong_behavior: Returns the reading after the trip, wrapped around the display maximum of 999999
comments.wrong_location: Rollover modulus checked; the addition may need to handle trips longer than a full cycle
